content: Online Boutique (GoogleCloudPlatform/microservices-demo) = 11 polyglot services over gRPC: frontend(Go), cartservice(C#/Redis), productcatalogservice(Go, serves from a JSON FILE not a DB), currencyservice, paymentservice(MOCK), shippingservice(MOCK), emailservice(MOCK), checkoutservice(Go, orchestrates payment/shipping/email SYNCHRONOUSLY), recommendationservice, adservice, loadgenerator. OMITS: durable catalog persistence, inventory/stock at all, any message broker or async events, sagas/compensation, idempotency keys, outbox, real failure handling. Its 'orchestration' is a synchronous gRPC fan-out, so there is no partial-failure or eventual-consistency problem to reason about.
